text:
raj: Need help reserving ND40rs_v2 capacity in FranceCentral + WestEurope for the Acme pilot. Two subscriptions (cross-tenant). Target start 2024-11-04. I will open support tickets but we need vNet port limit bump and core quota increases.

lisa: Can you drop the exact subscription IDs and tenant owners? I want to make sure the support request ties to the right accounts.

raj: subs: sub-0a1b2c3d (acme-prod-pool) tenant acme-corp; sub-4e5f6a7b (acme-staging) tenant acme-test. Tenant owners are alice@acme.com and devops@acme.com.

ben: I'll draft the Azure support request. We should request: ND40rs_v2 quota increase (per region), cores for the sku, and vNet NAT port increase from 120 -> 600 for both subs. Also ask for start date reservation for 2024-11-04 to 2025-02-04.

ashley: NSG/port limits are the likely blocker. Who owns the subscription-level support contact? If Acme needs to approve, we need an authorized contact in the request. Also confirm whether they want Dedicated reservation or just quota + SKUs available.

raj: Acme wants Dedicated (reserved) capacity for predictable throughput. They already signed the reserved capacity T&Cs. Contact is alice@acme.com (tenant admin). Please cc finance for cost approval.

ben: Opened support request draft and flagged as Priority C (capacity). SR draft note: "Request quota and capacity reservation for ND40rs_v2 in FranceCentral & WestEurope across subscriptions sub-0a1b2c3d and sub-4e5f6a7b. Include vNet NAT port limit increase and NSG ephemeral port guidance. Provide start date 2024-11-04. Provide ETA on reservation confirmation and any required tenant admin acceptance steps."

cloud-bot: Azure support link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/; draft SR id: 22014567 (internal draft, will be submitted once owners confirm).

maria: Finance — rough cost delta for reserved ND40rs_v2 for 3 months? Need an estimate to send to Acme for budget sign-off.

finance-bot: Estimated committed cost (3 months, ND40rs_v2 x 4 nodes): $58,800 USD (incl. infra surcharge). Requires PO from Acme to finalize.

ashley: For the vNet port increase, Azure will ask for the subnet and vNet names. Raj can you confirm those and whether we need NAT gateway adjustments?

raj: vNet names: acme-prod-vnet, acme-staging-vnet. Subnets: compute-subnet (both). They currently use a single NAT gateway per vNet; we plan to add SNAT scaling rules if needed.

ben: Submitted SR 22014567 -> Azure responded, asked for tenant admin acceptance for subscription linkage. They provided a tenant consent URL and a timeline: 72h after consent to confirm reservation options.

lisa: @alice (acme tenant admin) needs to click consent link and confirm subscription mapping. Raj please forward link to them and ask for a screenshot when done.

raj: forwarded link to alice, she acknowledged and will complete consent by EOD tomorrow.

cloud-bot: Azure response excerpt: "Reservation holds are provisionally available pending tenant admin acceptance and quota increase approval. vNet SNAT guidance provided; NSG ephemeral ports unchanged. If NAT capacity insufficient, recommend scaling NAT gateway SKU."

ashley: Action items: 1) raj to get tenant consent screenshot; 2) ben to follow up with Azure support to convert draft SR to confirmed reservation; 3) lisa to prepare infra changes (NAT scaling playbook); 4) maria to send cost estimate and PO template to Acme.

raj: I'll also schedule a smoke test for first deploy once reservation confirmed. Ben, can you outline quick smoke test steps?

ben: Smoke test plan (short):
```
1) Deploy minimal inference stack to reserved pool (k8s nodes tainted for nd40).
2) Run perf smoke: 100 concurrent short chats (seq len 64) to validate latency < 200ms p50.
3) Verify KV cache hits and batching metrics via /metrics endpoint.
4) Run failover: drain one node and confirm autoscheduling to remaining nodes < 90s.
```
Share logs and tracer IDs back to #eng-runtime.

maria: I sent estimate and PO template to alice. She asked whether we can start billing only after capacity confirmation. Finance says yes, invoicing can align to reservation activation.

cloud-bot: SR 22014567 updated: tenant consent received at 2024-08-05T15:12Z, quota increase request approved for cores, pending reservation allocation window. Azure expects final allocation by 2024-08-09.

raj: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the tracker. I'll post the confirmation once Azure allocates the reservation. :thumbsup:

lisa: Thanks — will prep NAT scaling playbook and a short runbook for oncall.

ben: I'll close loop with Azure once allocation is confirmed and post reservation IDs.

finance-bot: Noted PO terms; finance contact copied.

raj: closing for now, will reopen if any blockers crop up.
